root_motivation: Who: an agent whose user says 'the truth is this Google Sheet'. What: one host.sync.create call that makes a host table mirror an external dataset on a schedule. Why not today: host.table.create makes an empty table, host.table.append cannot update a row, and host.trigger.set can only call a published tool, so the agent owns a sync loop forever.
user_persona: An agent that calls host.sync.create with a source ref and gets a scheduled mirror in one call; Operator Joe who reads docs/tools.md and llms.txt and knows both were rendered from the SourceKind enum.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given this PRD has landed, When the operator runs the premise check recorded under 'Premise check (operator)', Then its result is written into the PRD (Live; deferred, operator-provisioned).
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred -- operator-provisioned: premise check over the last three truth-tier runs, recorded in the PRD.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given SourceKind::ALL, When a test renders the tool schema, docs/tools.md, www/llms.txt and reads the puller dispatch arms, Then every kind appears in each exactly once and gen-docs --check exits 1 naming the file after any one copy is hand-edited.

Given a keyed free tenant, When host.sync.create {source: {kind: csv_url, ref}, table: orders} is called, Then the response carries sync_id and next_run_unix within 15 minutes, host.sync.list shows one active row, and the call took < 100 ms.

Given kind excel_online, a csv_url ref of http://10.0.0.1/x.csv, and google_sheet on a tenant with no Google connection, When each is created, Then the errors are args_invalid (lists the five kinds), host_not_allowed and connection_missing {provider: google}, and no syncs row exists.
Given a free tenant with 5 syncs, When a sixth is created, Then quota_syncs_max {limit: 5, used: 5} is returned and host.quickstart limits.plan.syncs_max reads 5 from the same Plan field.

Given an active sync whose next_run_unix is in the past, When tick_once runs, Then one sync_runs receipt exists, next_run_unix moved to the next cron slot, and a second tick_once in the same slot writes no second receipt.
Given a sync, When host.sync.delete runs, Then host.sync.list is empty, the table still answers host.table.query, and a second host.sync.create with the same (kind, ref, table) returns a new sync_id.

Given prod after deploy, When the joe-test tenant calls host.sync.create for the public fixture CSV and then host.sync.get, Then the response carries sync_id and next_run_unix (Live; deferred, operator-provisioned).
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred -- operator-provisioned: examples/data-sync/proof.sh --create-only against prod after deploy.

scope: src/sync/mod.rs: the SourceKind registry, host.sync.create/list/get/delete/run_now, and the trigger tick's sync pass writing a not_implemented sync_runs receipt.
migrations/0130_syncs.sql: syncs and sync_runs tables; Plan.syncs_max (free 5, pro 50) and the quota_syncs_max, connection_missing and schedule_too_frequent error codes.
www/llms.txt gains a generated Data sync section and docs/tools.md the source.kind enum, both rendered from SourceKind.
non_goals: Fetching rows (the pull PRD); push or conflict handling (the two-way PRD); type inference beyond text columns; any new OAuth flow.

additional.main_database_tables: syncs and sync_runs live in the main database (migration 0130), not a per-tenant file, so the tick's sync pass is one indexed query across tenants.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent not keep a host table equal to a sheet?
five_whys_trace.a: No verb registers an external source; the agent would own a puller, a token and a diff loop.
host.table.append cannot update a row and host.trigger.set only calls a published tool.
One SourceKind enum generates the schema, docs and dispatch, so the five kinds cannot drift.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What is source.secret?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The NAME of a host.secret (stored as secret_name), never a value, so no secret-named field exists on a Debug struct.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Do push and two_way modes run?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: They are accepted at create with status pending_mode (the PRD default) and the tick skips them.
